# MockTestVault — Independent CBT Practice and Revision Resources

> https://mocktestvault.com/ provides free, browser-based practice tests, chapter drills and revision resources for selected Indian and international examinations. Test attempts, bookmarks and progress are stored in the user's browser. Optional Google Analytics is loaded only after an explicit analytics-consent choice; question attempts are not submitted to a MockTestVault account backend.

## Editorial and accuracy status
- MockTestVault is an independent practice resource. It is not the official software of CBSE, NCERT, SSC, NTA, ETS, College Board, IELTS, AWS, GMAC or any other examination body.
- The current bank contains 6,404 question records across 286 question-data JSON files (287 JSON files in the release including the web manifest). The records have structural checks, but a complete independent subject-matter re-solve has not been completed.
- 954 SSC/CBSE year- or shift-labelled records have not been authenticated item by item against original papers and official final answer keys. Treat them as year/shift-labelled practice material, not authenticated PYQs.
- Question citations may be curriculum or topic references rather than item-level source links. A topic reference does not prove that a question appeared in an official paper or that its selected answer matches an official key.
- Automated overlap detection found repeated stems across practice sets and mocks. Some reuse is intentional. Duplicate and explanation-variance registers are audit aids, not accuracy certifications.
- Review status and downloadable registers: https://mocktestvault.com/question-sources-review.html

## Current CBSE Class 10 resources
- [CBSE Class 10 practice catalogue](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/): 48 independent practice modules across Science, Mathematics and Social Science. This is not a certification of complete 2026–27 syllabus coverage.
- [CBSE Class 10 2026–27 syllabus and official sample-paper links](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/2026-27-syllabus-sample-papers.html): current official curriculum and sample-paper entry points, a revision workflow and limitations of the independent practice bank.
- [Mathematics formulas and theorems](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/math-formulas.html).
- [Science formulas and reactions](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science-formulas-reactions.html).
- Official CBSE Class X curriculum (2026–27): https://cbseacademic.nic.in/curriculum_2027.html
- Official CBSE Class X sample question papers and marking schemes (2026–27): https://cbseacademic.nic.in/sqp_classx_2026-27.html

## SSC CGL
- [SSC CGL Tier-I practice hub](https://mocktestvault.com/ssc-cgl/): independent practice mocks and sectional drills based on the 2026 notification pattern. Scores are practice scores, not SSC results.
- [SSC CGL syllabus and strategy guide](https://mocktestvault.com/ssc-cgl/tier-1-syllabus-strategy.html).
- Official SSC portal: https://ssc.gov.in/

- [India practice hub](https://mocktestvault.com/in/)

- [TOEFL reading practice](https://mocktestvault.com/global/toefl/reading-practice-01.html): legacy passage-based practice; not an adaptive 2026 TOEFL iBT simulation.
